title: Very Nice- great for a guest bedroom!
text: Very Nice- great for a guest bedroom!. Wonderful item. Looks amazing in my guest bedroom. If you have a cable box just measure the width to ensure it will fit. The shelf is 14 inches (inside wall to inside wall of shelf) The older cable boxes can be bigger but I just contacted Verizon and asked for a smaller box. It’s a beautiful piece of furniture that doesn’t look as inexpensive as it is which is perfect!

product_metadata.title: Walker Edison Richmond Modern Farmhouse Sliding Barn Door TV Stand for TVs up to 65 Inches, 58 Inch, White and Rustic Oak
features: Dimensions: 28” H x 15.75” D x 58” L, Cabinet: 23.25” H x 13.25” D x 15.25” L
Top surface supports up to 150 Ibs. and shelves support up to 30 Ibs. each
Supports TVs up to 65” and 6 cord management ports keep cables tidy
description: This TV stand will give your living room a charming country feel, while also providing plenty of storage space for your electronics and décor. Featuring two sliding barn door styled cabinet fronts for a versatile design where you can either close off the middle or both sides, depending on your needs. Adjustable shelving and cable management make it simple for you to keep your electronics in one place. This media console is constructed of high-grade MDF. The modern farmhouse style of this entertainment center will become a piece in your living room you’ll admire.
